designationHistory.name: Dominguez-Escalante National Conservation Area
designationHistory.indexText: The Omnibus Public Land Management Act of 2009 established the Dominguez-Escalante National Conservation Area in Colorado.

authority.citation: Public Law 111-11, title II, sec. 2402, 123 Stat. 991, 1102

designationHistory.note: The statute spells the name with a hyphen, not a slash.
